---
title: What is TraderSwift AI?
description: An AI that gets to know you through the tools you use, and only through what you let it read.
order: 22
part: TraderSwift AI and compute
---

The more of TraderSwift's tools you use, the better TraderSwift AI knows you, and the better it can serve you.

That is TraderSwift AI, and it is our long-term focus.

## What will it do for me?

TraderSwift AI is meant to serve you inside TraderSwift.

What it does for you at launch is not decided yet. The aim is that it serves you better the more of your own tools it can see, and the next section shows why.

## Why does it get better with use?

Each tool holds a different part of your work.

- **Ledger** – what you need to do and decide.
- **Vault** – your notes, research and files.
- **Signals** – the trade ideas you publish or follow.
- **Signer** – the limits you set for your agents.

An AI that can see these together can help in ways that an AI seeing only one of them cannot. [Chapter 16](16-what-are-ledger-and-vault.html) explains Ledger and Vault.

So you don't have to explain yourself to it from the start. What you already keep in your own tools is what it works from, if you let it.

## What can it read?

Only what you grant it.

It uses the same grants as any other app or agent. [Chapter 18](18-where-is-my-data-kept-and-who-can-read-it.html) explains how grants work.

If you have not granted a part of your data, the AI does not read it. That is a rule of the design.

## What will it never do?

- It never places an order.
- It never moves funds.
- It never signs anything.

Orders still go through Signer, inside the limits you set. [Chapter 09](09-how-does-an-order-get-signed-and-how-do-i-stop-it.html) explains that.

So even a helpful AI cannot trade your account on its own.

## What will it do at launch?

That is not decided yet.

We will say so on this page when it is.

## Where is what it learns kept?

That is not decided yet either.

It matters, because what an AI learns about you is your data too. We will state the answer here before the AI goes live.

## Can other agents use it?

That is the aim.

Other agents will be able to pay to ask TraderSwift AI a question, one request at a time. [Chapter 20](20-what-is-the-marketplace-and-how-do-builders-get-paid.html) explains paying per request.

## What does it run on?

[Chapter 23](23-what-does-traderswift-ai-run-on.html) explains the computers behind it.

## What is live?

**Planned.** What it does at launch, and where it learns, are not decided yet.
